description.zh: 帮猫狗主人做好日常照顾：按出生日期或上次记录排出疫苗和驱虫日程并导出手机提醒，讲解喂养换粮、洗护、绝育和正向训练，列出有毒食物和需要立即就医的危险信号。不诊断、不开药，健康问题以兽医为准。
description.en: Helps cat and dog owners with everyday care: vaccine and deworming schedules from birth dates or past records with phone reminders, feeding and food transitions, grooming, neutering and positive training, plus toxic foods and red flags that need a vet. No diagnoses or prescriptions.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你家毛孩子是猫还是狗、多大了
welcome_message.en: Tell me whether you have a cat or a dog and how old they are

prompt.zh: 我家 ___（猫/狗）___ 出生，帮我排疫苗和驱虫日程。
prompt.en: My ___ (cat/dog) was born on ___. Plan vaccines and deworming.

prompt.zh: 上次打疫苗是 ___，驱虫是 ___，下次什么时候？
prompt.en: Last vaccine ___, last deworming ___. When is the next?

prompt.zh: 我家 ___ 吃了 ___，现在 ___，要去医院吗？
prompt.en: My ___ ate ___ and is now ___. Should we see a vet?

prompt.zh: ___ 个月的 ___，一天喂几次？怎么换粮？
prompt.en: A ___-month-old ___: how often to feed and how to switch food?

prompt.zh: 我家 ___ 总是 ___（乱尿/扑人/咬东西），怎么训练？
prompt.en: My ___ keeps ___ (peeing indoors/jumping/chewing). How do I train it?

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 的疫苗驱虫日程导出到手机日历。
prompt.en: Export ___'s vaccine and deworming schedule to my phone calendar.

zh: 每月 1 日「09:00」列出本月的疫苗和驱虫待办
疫苗接种前 3 天「20:00」提醒预约宠物医院
每月体外驱虫日「09:00」提醒用药并记录
每周日「10:00」提醒称体重并记录
每年 3 月 1 日「10:00」提醒做年度体检和狂犬疫苗
每季度第一天「10:00」检查宠物食品、驱虫药库存和保质期
en: On the 1st of each month at 09:00, list this month's vaccines and deworming
3 days before a vaccination at 20:00, remind to book the vet
On each monthly external deworming day at 09:00, remind to apply and log it
Every Sunday at 10:00, remind to weigh and log
On March 1 at 10:00, remind about the annual checkup and rabies shot
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, check food and medicine stock and expiry
